scope: every one of the 164864 admitted words; no sampling, prefix or limit parameter
history: Frozen after the earlier 20000-word exploratory report and before full-corpus outcomes; this is not a blinded study.
purpose: Determine complete-corpus information contribution and address dependence; retain useful metadata as metadata. No lexical or inference usefulness is inferred from uniqueness alone.

execution.primary: execute the pinned native word_views for every word; bind the verified motion implementation once rather than repeating file hashes and Git subprocesses for each word; no formula is replaced
execution.reconstruction: independent exact sum and constituent-set implementation, compared to the complete native record for every word; then separate complete independent process replay
execution.storage: aggregate evidence and ordered complete-observation digest only; individual views remain recomputable from the source
execution.completion: all corpus counts, all words, every view subset, all renumberings, no native/reconstruction disagreements, matching terminal evidence objects, unchanged database bytes
execution.stop: source mismatch, corpus mismatch, integrity error, resource failure, computation error or record disagreement; no arbitrary wall-clock cutoff

comparisons.subsets: all 15 nonempty subsets of the four views
comparisons.missingness: view 1 None when fewer than two definitions; never convert absence to zero density
comparisons.anagram_control: all same-glyph-multiset groups across the complete corpus, including all multiword groups

renumbering_controls.word_id_reverse: i -> N+1-i with all word references relabelled consistently; view1/2/4 should be invariant
renumbering_controls.word_id_affine_157: i -> 1 + (157*(i-1) mod N), a checked bijection, with all word references relabelled consistently; view1/2/4 should be invariant
renumbering_controls.glyph_id_reverse: j -> C+1-j with all glyph references relabelled consistently; exposes dependence of view2/3/4 on glyph addresses
renumbering_controls.execution: evaluate these exact counterfactual formulas for every source word; never mutate the corpus database
renumbering_controls.interpretation: sensitivity establishes address dependence, not uselessness; source-qualified addresses may provide useful stable memory

decision_rules.redundancy: a view adds no distinctions conditional on the others when removing it leaves the exact full-corpus partition unchanged; preserve derivable witness functions where operationally useful
decision_rules.identity: one distinct address per word is a control, not evidence of semantic utility
decision_rules.geometry: overlap diagnostics do not replace definition-axis orthogonality; endpoint views do not replace ordered construction
decision_rules.inclusion: this audit supports scoped information/metadata decisions, not automatic neural-input or universal-geometry selection

resource_preflight.execution: two complete processes; stdlib only; no paid API, training or GPU

hmmm: Downstream inference usefulness requires an actual task and acceptance criterion.
Stable addressing requires source-qualified identity and explicit remapping across corpus versions.
Geometric selection and higher closure retain their owning UCNS/Stack boundaries.
